articles.title: Did a President Really Spend $200 on Ice Cream in One Summer?
articles.summary: July is National Ice Cream Month, and the facts are wild! From ancient emperors to a 3,010-pound scoop, ice cream has a surprising history. Even George Washington was a superfan.

articles.title: Spider-Man Just Swung Into the Record Books!
articles.summary: The new Spider-Man movie, 'Brand New Day,' earned a jaw-dropping $927 million in its first weekend. That's the second-biggest opening ever, behind only 'Avengers: Endgame.' Peter Parker is back and bigger than ever!

articles.title: Marvel's 'Wonder Man' Show Canceled—Even Though Everyone Was Ready to Go!
articles.summary: The Disney+ series 'Wonder Man' won't get a second season, and the show's co-creator is speaking out. He says contracts were signed and schedules cleared, so the sudden cancellation surprised everyone, including the star.
